124: After a young man is murdered, his spirit stays behind to warn his lover of impending danger, with the help of a reluctant psychic.
Before Sam was murdered, he told Molly he'd love and protect her forever.

There's no such thing as free cable.

A story of two friends who didn't know they were supposed to be enemies.

Get ready to kick some grass!

Fate of one. Future of all.

A trip back in time from the present to...

A Dangerous Mind is a terrible thing to waste.

Deception is their most dangerous weapon.

Share it with someone you love.

A comedy about the journey between popping the question and tying the knot.

The horror film with a heart of mystery.

Birth and death are extraordinary experiences. Life is a fleeting pleasure.
5244: In the aftermath of an unspeakable act of terror, Police Sergeant Tommy Saunders joins courageous survivors, first responders and investigators in a race against the clock to hunt down the Boston Marathon bombers before they strike again.
The inside story of the world's greatest manhunt.

Liberation. Whether they want it or not.

Lawrence 'Larry' Stewart Talbot / The Wolf Man

King Fausto of the Sixth Dimension
Queen Doris of the Sixth Dimension

Growing Up Can Be Painfully Funny.

TODAY - THE POND... TOMORROW - THE WORLD!

A Tsunami Just Flipped The Foodchain.

Now Simon has escaped and has started killing women again, and O'Brien is the only man who can stop him.
14460: An awkward, unemployed man who can talk to the dead teams up with a rebellious bartender to find the vengeful ghost that's been terrorizing their town.
This dead end town just got a lot deader.

Life is a force of nature

Makes "Night of the Living Dead" Look Like a Kids' Pajama Party!
19324: A mild-mannered secretary discovers that she has a talent for murder as she ascends the corporate ladder.
Climbing the corporate ladder can be murder.

This accident is the threshold of the coincidences that bring Ozgur and Deniz together.

Fake it until you break it.

The Incredible True Story of Formula One's Greatest Family.

22140: Seventeen-year-olds Miku and Elias find themselves, and each other, during a summer in the Finnish countryside.
This nordic summer is all about being screwed

The Spider will eat you alive!

Same age, same space and different life…

The power of family will decide the fate of love

Israel, 1973... One woman stood between victory and defeat.

Featuring the superhit song "Aati Kya Khandala" sung by Aamir Khan.

Love comes and goes but land stays.

To battle monsters, become a monster.

25980: A year after the first movie, the four friends are enjoying their lives to the fullest, get in trouble once again with Bholi, who is released from prison earlier than expected and is broke.

It starts as an infection. It ends in devastation.

The Biography of the Woman Boss of Bad Girls...

DYNAMITE hits the screen with their kind of love!

The action is so fast... it's a wonder Tony Rome stays alive... and single!

They can demolish a building, but never remove the past.

Humanity dwells in the most unexpected places.

Out of the darkness comes the ear-piercing cry of a terrified girl...
